subject: Post-demo: deployment suitability + HIPAA/SOC2 evidence and next steps
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: David Lane <d.lane@clinix.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-07T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: deployment suitability + HIPAA/SOC2 evidence and next steps

Hi David —

Thanks for the time earlier. Quick written recap and proposed next steps so we can align with your procurement/security timelines. High-level takeaways from our call: 

- ClinicalX will process PHI in the inference path (EHR-derived notes + identifiers for matching).
- Primary constraints: need a signed BAA, SOC2 Type II evidence, and audit log retention of 7 years for certain workflows.
- Preference: Internal product team would prefer to try Hosted for speed, but security/procurement flagged need for stronger isolation/evidence if PHI remains in scope.

Recommended path (preliminary):
- Short term: Schedule a 60-min security deep-dive with our infra/security SMEs to map data flows and confirm whether Hosted with a BAA is acceptable for the initial pilot.
- If procurement/security require network isolation or on-prem controls, the natural fit would be Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pool) or Private VPC option; we'll surface the minimal evidence set for each route.

Immediate asks from us to accelerate qualification:
1) Can you share the internal security questionnaire (redacted OK) prior to the call? Upload to the secure Drive link below.
2) Who from ClinicalX will own the BAA review (legal / procurement / security)?
3) Do you have a target date for procurement sign-off / pilot start?

Attachments: example_BAA_template.docx (stub) — a redlineable starting point.

Proposed times for the security deep-dive: Wed 2028-06-14 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu 2028-06-15 14:00–15:00 PT. Please tell me which works for your security lead and we’ll send calendar invites.

Link (secure upload): https://drive.redwood.ai/secure/clinix-security-pre-read
HubSpot record: https://hub.redwood.ai/deals/RWI-2028-CLX-17

Thanks — we want to make the hosting decision low-friction for your team; will surface the minimal docs required for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private.

Best,
Soojin
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
[attachment: example_BAA_template.docx]

From: David Lane <d.lane@clinix.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: ClinicalX Security <security@clinix.ai>
Date: 2028-06-07T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: deployment suitability + HIPAA/SOC2 evidence and next steps

Soojin —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few notes from our side:

- We appreciate the Hosted flow for speed, but our security team has said we cannot put PHI into a public-hosted tenant without a signed BAA and explicit SOC2 evidence mapped to the controls we require.
- Current procurement window: aiming for a pilot start by 2028-07-15, but that slips if security can’t validate the controls this month.
- I’m attaching our security questionnaire (SSQ) — it’s the canonical doc procurement will use.

Short answers to your asks:
1) SSQ attached (ClinicalX_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx).
2) Ownership: procurement/legal will own contract review (Rachel Kim), security will run the technical validation (I’ve copied security@clinix.ai here).
3) Target: pilot by 7/15 but need the security deep-dive before June 20 to stay on track.

Given our retention and audit needs I suspect we’ll either need a Dedicated pool or a Private VPC for production, but open to an initial Hosted pilot if Redwood can provide: (a) SOC2 Type II report, (b) a BAA, and (c) an architecture diagram showing PHI segregation and audit logs.

-David
David Lane
Head of Product Ops | Clinix AI
[attachment: ClinicalX_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: David Lane <d.lane@clinix.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-07T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: deployment suitability + HIPAA/SOC2 evidence and next steps

David —

Got the questionnaire, thanks. That timeline makes sense — we should be able to hit a pre-read/validation meeting before June 20 if we lock in time this week. A few clarifications so we prepare the right artifacts:

- For Hosted with PHI in scope we will require an executed BAA; we can provide a standard BAA and a redlineable draft quickly.
- SOC2: we can provide a redacted SOC2 Type II pack (control summary + auditor letter + system description). We will send a redacted pack as pre-read; the full set is typically under NDA/secure sharing.
- If ClinicalX needs network isolation or customer-managed keys, Dedicated or Private VPC is the appropriate long-term path; we’ll outline the differences (SLA/throughput/cost) in the meeting.

Proposed immediate steps: 
1) Security deep-dive with your security lead + our infra/security: Mon 2028-06-12 09:00–10:00 PT or Wed 2028-06-14 10:00–11:00 PT (we have SMEs available both slots).
2) I’ll upload a redacted SOC2 summary and a BAA draft to the Drive before EOD.
3) Post-call: we’ll produce a short deployment suitability matrix (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) tailored to your retention/audit asks and call out the minimal evidence set required for each.

I’m looping in Karthik to own the deep-dive and the artifact delivery.

Best,
Soojin
[attachment: SOC2_summary_redacted.pdf]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-07T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo: deployment suitability + HIPAA/SOC2 evidence and next steps — internal prep

Team —

Forwarding David’s SSQ and the ask. Quick internal plan so we move fast: 

- Karthik: own the deep-dive (data flows + audit log mapping). Bring our infra runbook and the deployment suitability matrix draft.
- Marissa: own contract/BAA workstream and timing for a redlineable BAA. 
- Grace: prep SOC2 redacted pack & system description; have a one-pager that maps ClinicalX SSQ controls to our SOC2 controls.

Draft pre-read I’ll publish to the secure Drive by EOD. On the call we should present: 1) a one-slide data flow with PHI touchpoints; 2) a short matrix (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) with the minimum evidence and expected procurement impact; 3) timelines to deliver the artifacts (SOC2 summary, BAA, architecture).

Next internal checkpoints: 
- Karthik to run a 30-min prep sync with infra on Thu 6/8 11:00 PT.
- Draft matrix to me by Thu 6/8 17:00 PT.

Also note — HubSpot deal RWI-2028-CLX-17 is currently marked as "evaluation"; if risk is higher we should flag for sales-assist and finance to review potential credit / pilot terms.

Soojin

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: David Lane <d.lane@clinix.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-08T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: deployment suitability + HIPAA/SOC2 evidence and next steps

David / team —

Thanks for the SSQ and the quick turnaround on timelines. We’ve scheduled the security deep-dive for Wed 2028-06-14 10:00–11:00 PT (calendar invite to follow). For pre-read I’ve uploaded the following to the secure Drive link in Soojin’s note: 

- SOC2_TypeII_Report_redacted.pdf (control summary + auditor letter)
- BAA_Draft_Redline.docx (our standard template with a few callouts for retention/audit logs)
- Deployment_Suitability_Matrix_Clinix.pdf (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private — control/evidence/cost/tradeoffs)

Short answers up-front: 
- Hosted: can support a short pilot if a BAA is executed and the SSQ controls that map to the PHI path are satisfied; requires explicit audit log config and retention SLA changes (we can scope).
- Dedicated: recommended if ClinicalX requires tenant-level isolation and customer-managed keys; higher cost, predictable throughput, faster ability to get a BAA without additional network constraints.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): necessary only if procurement mandates customer-managed networking or full air-gapped control; longest lead time.

Please confirm the security attendee (name + email) from your side for the deep-dive so we can tailor the technical pre-read.

Karthik
Head of Infrastructure | Redwood Inference
[attachments: SOC2_TypeII_Report_redacted.pdf, BAA_Draft_Redline.docx, Deployment_Suitability_Matrix_Clinix.pdf]
